+## Summary
+
+Increase the cache TTL for pricing data from 15 minutes to 1 hour. This reduces the frequency of cache invalidation and lowers the load on the pricing feed during peak usage periods.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Raised `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 (15 minutes → 1 hour)
+- Simplified the pricing_cache module by removing an unused `lookup()` function
+
+## Impact
+
+Pricing data will remain cached for longer, resulting in:
+- Fewer requests to the pricing feed
+- Reduced latency for cache hits
+- Lower backend load during periods of high traffic
+
+The trade-off is that pricing updates will take up to 1 hour to propagate through the cache instead of 15 minutes. This is acceptable for pricing data that changes infrequently.
